["test_catalog.py","import json
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

from catalog import clean_names


class CleanNamesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_input(self):
        self.assertEqual(clean_names([]), [])

    def test_whitespace_only_names_are_discarded(self):
        self.assertEqual(clean_names(["   ", "\t\n", ""]), [])

    def test_duplicates_after_trimming_are_removed(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            clean_names(["  Alice  ", "Alice", " Bob ", "bob", "  Alice "]),
            ["Alice", "Bob"],
        )

    def test_order_preserves_first_occurrence(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            clean_names(["  zeta ", "alpha", "  zeta", "beta", "alpha"]),
            ["zeta", "alpha", "beta"],
        )

    def test_unicode_names(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            clean_names(["  李雷 ", "李雷", " 韩梅梅 ", " 李雷"]),
            ["李雷", "韩梅梅"],
        )

    def test_cli_outputs_json(self):
        proc = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "catalog.py", "  Alice  ", "Alice", "", "  Bob ", "Bob"],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            check=True,
        )
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(proc.stdout), ["Alice", "Bob"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
"]
